keyEvents.event: Nazi occupation kills a quarter of the population
keyEvents.impact: Great Patriotic War memory is the regime's founding myth and glue with Moscow

keyEvents.event: Chernobyl fallout contaminates a fifth of the country
keyEvents.impact: Deep distrust of distant authorities and lasting public-health trauma
Began three decades of personalist rule preserving a Soviet-style state economy
Framework for economic and military integration that Moscow increasingly uses to absorb Minsk

keyEvents.event: Stolen election and mass protests crushed
keyEvents.impact: Regime survived only with Kremlin backing; Western sanctions and over 1,000 political prisoners followed

keyEvents.event: Territory used as launchpad for Russia's assault on Kyiv
keyEvents.impact: Belarus became a co-belligerent in Western eyes without committing its own troops

keyEvents.event: Russian tactical nuclear weapons deployed; Wagner briefly hosted
keyEvents.impact: Belarus turned into Russia's forward nuclear bastion facing Poland and the Baltics

keyEvents.event: Seventh term, Zapad-2025 exercise and US-brokered prisoner releases
keyEvents.impact: Lukashenko trades prisoners for US sanctions relief on Belavia and potash to gain room from Moscow

keyEvents.event: Oreshnik missiles on combat duty; 250 prisoners freed for US banking and potash relief
keyEvents.impact: Deeper nuclear dependency on Russia coexists with a cautious thaw with Washington while EU sanctions stay

history.narrative: A Soviet-style personal dictatorship that survives on Russian subsidies, repression and Lukashenko's knack for playing patrons against each other. It hosts Russian nuclear weapons yet keeps its own army out of Ukraine, and bargains prisoners for sanctions relief whenever Moscow's grip tightens.

redLines.description: Western-backed color revolution or support for the exiled opposition
NATO or Ukrainian military action on Belarusian soil
Loss of Russian energy subsidies and market access that keep the economy afloat

internalDivisions.name: Suppressed democratic opposition from the 2020 uprising
Nomenklatura succession uncertainty around an aging Lukashenko

goals.description: Ensure regime survival against internal opposition and Western pressure
Keep Russian protection and nuclear umbrella without full absorption into Russia
Trade political prisoners for lifting of US sanctions on potash, banks and aviation
Avoid direct entry into the Ukraine war while hosting Russian forces
